name: pinyin-duck
description: PinyinDuck: a Pinyin input method with real-time English definitions for Mandarin learners

scripts.build: npm run build:dict && npm run build:rime && npm run --workspaces --if-present build
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @pinyinduck/core && npm run test:coverage -w @pinyinduck/rime
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage:all: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pinyinduck/core && npm run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
